scripts.snapshot: docker compose -f ../../infra/docker-compose.yml exec -T directus npx directus schema snapshot --yes /directus/snapshots/schema.yaml && cp ../../infra/data/directus-snapshots/schema.yaml ./snapshots/schema.yaml || echo 'Lancer la stack Docker (infra/) puis réessayer'
scripts.apply: docker compose -f ../../infra/docker-compose.yml exec -T directus npx directus schema apply --yes /directus/snapshots/schema.yaml
